## Recipe Found: **Baked Salmon Fillets Dijon**

**Recipe URL:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/22538/baked-salmon-fillets-dijon/

### Key Details:
- **Rating:** ⭐ 4.6 stars (out of 5)
- **Reviews:** 1,133 reviews (with 1,588 total ratings)
- **Primary Seasoning:** **Dijon-style mustard** (3 tablespoons prepared Dijon-style mustard)
- **Estimated Cooking Time:** 15 minutes cook time (Total: 25 mins; Prep: 10 mins)

### Verification of Criteria:
| Criterion | Required | Found | ✓/✗ |
|-----------|----------|-------|------|
| Baked salmon recipe | Yes | Baked Salmon Fillets Dijon | ✓ |
| At least 50 reviews | ≥ 50 | 1,133 | ✓ |
| Rating ≥ 4.5 stars | ≥ 4.5 | 4.6 | ✓ |
